settlementMerit.rationale: St Andrews remains a top-tier destination with major medieval monuments, world-famous golf heritage, beaches, museums, three live Treasure Trails and a broad verified daytime café offer. The audit retains only correctly located public facilities and does not borrow Craigtoun or other surrounding attractions.

eat.focus: Cafés, coffee and cake, tearooms, farm cafés, breakfast and light lunches; full-meal restaurants excluded.
eat.note: Ten verified café, coffee-and-cake or light-lunch choices retained after adding three missed current venues.

trails.note: Three live Treasure Trails plus three official/self-guided routes retained.

accessibility.note: Venue and route access is stated only when a current source supports it; no blanket claim is made.

exclusions: Craigtoun and other surrounding attractions are not transferred.
Dinner-led restaurants, hotels, pubs and unverified OSM food records are excluded.
Private, residential and university-only parking is not published as general visitor parking.

boundaryRule: Only visitor places inside St Andrews's strict study area count toward the settlement score. Explicit related context may be shown but cannot inflate the town.
